summary: Three concrete gaps resolved before coding; actual native rename/collision primitive passes with producer target directory lease, component proof pending.

real_problems.goal: Stable exact bytes/IDs and bounded publication inputs
real_problems.finding: Input/serialization/identity persistence rules are not selected
real_problems.scenario: Retry reallocates IDs or adds current timestamps/order changes to manifest, so a logically same publication becomes a new conflicting package
real_problems.resolution: Closed local-bank-draft/1 DRAFT.json plus exact files in a preexisting private source/<transaction_id> root. Caller IDs/created_at preserved, no allocations; deterministic sorted manifest/files, no rewrite of document/original bytes. Existing package never replaced; source request validates before directory creation.

real_problems.goal: Native same-volume no-overwrite marker publication while directories stay confined
real_problems.finding: Actual initial MoveFileExW probe fails WinError32 under the existing reader directory share-read lease
real_problems.scenario: Reuse native reader lease for target directory; protected marker cannot be renamed and producer remains incomplete
real_problems.impact: Blocks every native publication with that lease
real_problems.resolution: Own producer target DirectoryLease permits read/write sharing with no delete sharing, validated private ACL/final path/reparse/root parents. Source uses unchanged strict reader leases. Native second probe passes flushed rename/file identity and collision183 preserving both files. MoveFileExW flags8 only, no replace/copy/delay flags.

real_problems.goal: No false failure after marker publication; no silent partial-package overwrite
real_problems.scenario: Process dies just before rename or response fails after rename; generic error/new IDs hides old published package or overwrites incomplete files
real_problems.impact: Main publication and later save recovery
real_problems.resolution: Explicit publish/inspect/resume. Publish never fills/rewrites existing incomplete package; resume only finishes an exact fully verified manifest+payload+READY.pending matching prepared inputs, no missing-file repair. Post-move/result loss UNKNOWN; inspect verifies retained bytes without source. Publication always Bank accepted=false; app performs refs/CAS/durable receipt validation.

questions.question: How to represent prepared producer inputs and stable identities without introducing a new canonical protocol?
questions.proposal: Select a closed bounded helper/CLI draft input mapped to existing full-revision manifest and exact files. Caller-supplied valid IDs persist unchanged; if allocation is supported for a new intent, record allocated IDs once in an exclusive recoverable draft before publication. Review input trust and replay rules first.

questions.question: Which no-overwrite atomic Windows publication primitive meets the existing contract?
questions.proposal: Choose and independently test a native same-volume primitive with no replacement flag, flushed READY.pending and explicit collision/fault outcomes. Do not use replacement rename or claim untested durability; unavailable primitive is a technical block, not permission to simulate success.
